title: Supported cautious observation
purpose: Confirm that a cautious claim directly supported by cited internal evidence does not require a false-positive semantic risk.
evidence_finding: In the synthetic sample, 18 of 100 accounts had declining weekly usage.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to the synthetic usage-summary rows.
evidence_limitations: The sample describes only the supplied period and does not establish causation.
claim: In this synthetic sample, 18% of accounts had declining weekly usage during the observed period.
rationale: The wording stays within the cited observation and states the synthetic scope.

title: Unsupported ROI and budget
purpose: Detect a financial recommendation not supported by the cited operational evidence.
evidence_finding: The synthetic evidence reports churn counts by segment.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to the synthetic churn summary.
evidence_limitations: No cost, revenue, margin, budget, or ROI evidence is present.
claim: Approve a $50,000 retention budget because it will generate a 3x ROI.
rationale: The valid churn citation does not support the proposed spend or return.

title: Association presented as causation
purpose: Detect a causal conclusion drawn from observational association.
evidence_finding: In the synthetic sample, declining usage and churn occur together more often than in other rows.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to the synthetic cross-tabulation.
evidence_limitations: The analysis is observational and does not control for alternative causes.
claim: Declining usage causes customers to churn.
rationale: Co-occurrence can support an association but not a causal claim.

title: Synthetic external context used as company fact
purpose: Detect external context presented as direct evidence about the company.
evidence_finding: Synthetic external demo context: a fictional industry brief says subscription firms may face seasonal churn.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to synthetic external context, not company-specific evidence.
evidence_limitations: The external example is explicitly synthetic and contains no company-specific observations.
claim: Our company is losing customers because of the industry's seasonal churn pattern.
rationale: External synthetic context cannot establish a company-specific cause, and the phrase 'because of' also makes causation_overreach a defensible additional label.

title: Data Engineer makes a strategic sales decision
purpose: Detect a recommendation outside the producing role's allowed boundary.
evidence_finding: The synthetic pipeline check found two fields that require validation.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to the synthetic data-readiness finding.
evidence_limitations: The evidence addresses data readiness and contains no sales authorization.
claim: Sales should launch the retention campaign next week without further approval.
rationale: Data readiness evidence does not authorize a Data Engineer to direct sales strategy.

title: Planned validation presented as complete
purpose: Detect a completion claim when cited evidence records only planned work.
evidence_finding: The synthetic plan states that segment validation is the next priority.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to the stated validation priority.
evidence_limitations: No execution result, approval record, or completed validation is present.
claim: Segment validation is complete and the outreach list is approved.
rationale: A priority to perform validation is not evidence that validation or approval occurred.

title: Citation does not support the claim
purpose: Detect a semantic mismatch despite a syntactically valid evidence citation.
evidence_finding: The synthetic evidence reports missing values in the account-region field.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points only to the missing-value finding.
evidence_limitations: The evidence contains no contract preference or customer interview data.
claim: Customers prefer annual contracts over monthly contracts.
rationale: Citation syntax is valid, but the cited finding is unrelated to contract preference.

title: Ambiguous partial support
purpose: Allow more than one defensible risk label when a claim upgrades an unverified investigation hypothesis into a company-specific likelihood and action priority.
evidence_finding: A synthetic user assumption says low-usage accounts may deserve retention review.
evidence_supporting_evidence: A valid EvidenceObject citation points to the assumption and labels it as unverified.
evidence_limitations: The assumption has not been validated against company outcomes.
The evidence does not establish causation.
claim: Low-usage accounts are likely a high-churn segment and should be prioritized for the retention pilot.
rationale: The claim turns an explicitly unverified idea to investigate into a company-specific churn likelihood and retention priority; human reviewers may defensibly label that as citation mismatch or unsupported company-specific support.
